messages:
maya: FYI running a 5% canary for v3.2-int4. quick scan of the smoke dashboards shows a ~1.6% drop in MRR on the short-answer slice and a +2.8% bump in hallucination-rate on longform. link: https://rwd/dash/canary/17679

maya: i'd like to codify an autofallback policy for this bring-up. prefer conservative thresholds to avoid noisy rollbacks but want to catch real regressions. thinking MRR delta, hallucination spike, latency tail. input? :thinking_face:

devin: proposal to start:
- hard-rollback if MRR drop >= 2.0% on primary slices (short-answer, api-summaries)
- OR hallucination rate increase >= 3.0% overall
- OR p95 latency increase >= 100ms
- require the condition to persist for 5 minutes (rolling)

sriram: add a reserved concordance check vs shadow baseline. if concordance on the reserved set drops >= 2.5% => trigger. catches semantic regressions missing from MRR.

joel: suggest two-tier actions: soft-action (auto-throttle to 50% traffic + run expanded smoke eval) vs hard-rollback. only escalate to hard-rollback if expanded eval confirms degradation. reduces flip-flop risk.

ana: latency nuance: many quant variants show bursts on kv-cache miss. p95 > 50ms should trigger a cooldown (limit traffic velocity) before a rollback. i.e., cooldown -> throttle -> rollback sequence.

maya: sketching a candidate YAML for the policy:

```yaml
policy_name: grok-guard-v3-int4
stages:
  - stage: canary
    traffic: 5%
    duration: 30m
  - stage: ramp
    traffic: 25%
    duration: 2h
triggers:
  - id: mrr_short_api
    slicer: [short-answer, api-summaries]
    comparator: relative
    threshold: -0.015   # -1.5%
    window_seconds: 300  # 5 min
    min_samples: 2000
    action: hard-rollback
  - id: hallucination
    comparator: relative
    threshold: 0.03     # +3%
    window_seconds: 300
    min_samples: 2000
    action: hard-rollback
  - id: concordance_reserved
    comparator: relative
    threshold: -0.025  # -2.5%
    window_seconds: 600  # 10 min
    action: auto-throttle
  - id: p95_latency
    comparator: absolute
    threshold: 50        # ms
    window_seconds: 300
    action: cooldown
hysteresis:
  block_promote_minutes: 1440  # 24h block after any auto-rollback unless manual override
logging:
  snapshot_on_trigger: true  # include prompt, seed, kv_hit flag in snapshot
```

maya: thoughts on -1.5% threshold for stage1? i set it a touch conservative because it's quant optimized. we can tighten to -1.0% at 25% traffic.

devin: agree. include the min_samples floor (N=2000) so tiny windows don't trip it.

sriram: please ensure snapshot includes request metadata (prompt, seed, kv-hit, model variant) so we can replay quickly. also tag snapshots with the traffic cohort.

joel: add an explicit expanded-smoke job that runs within the autoscaling test harness when soft-action triggers. expanded-smoke should run the reserved concordance set + longform hallucination probes. if expanded-smoke fails, escalate to hard-rollback automatically.

deploy-bot: canary started: model=v3.2-int4 variant=quant-bridge traffic=5% started_at=1767994321

ops-bot: telemetry alert: p95 latency on canary nodes spiked +62ms at 1767994402 (kv-cache refill). window overlaps hallucination uptick.

maya: perfect. i'll add min_samples, expanded-smoke job, snapshot fields, and hysteresis to the PR. i'll also add a Console metric 'auto_fallback_count' per-policy as ana asked previously. i'll open PR in ~20m.

devin: apply command once PR is merged:
`rwdctl rollout apply --policy grok-guard-v3-int4 --env canary`

ana: please also surface a per-slice breakdown in Console for these triggers so PMs/SEs can inspect which slices caused the action.

maya: will do, will ping when PR is up for review. leaving this thread as the action list. :white_check_mark:

joel: will review. ping me if you want a walk-through of the expanded-smoke job.
